description: A pipeline of edits in one call: each op runs on the result of the one before, and a later op takes an id an earlier op made with {"$ref":"ops[N].clip_id"} (or track_id, clip_ids[M]). Unrelated edits go in one pipeline too; order matters only when one edit uses the result of another. One new timeline_id and one preview at the end; all apply or none do. Separate edit calls each start from the timeline_id they are given, so they run one after another. Returns the edit result plus results: [{tool, clip_id?, clip_ids?, track_id?}] per op.

ops.description: Edits applied in order as one change. An arg may be {"$ref":"ops[2].clip_id"} to use an id made by an earlier op

preview.description: inline: image in the result; link: URI that renders on read; none

timeline_id.description: Timeline handle; every edit returns a new one

name: edit.batch

changed.description: What the edit added, removed or modified; a clip or transition says its track and where it now sits (frames, end exclusive)

clip_id.description: The clip this edit made or acted on (each tool says which)

clip_ids.description: Every clip this edit made or acted on, linked ones included (each tool says which)

parent.description: The version this edit started from

placements.description: Where each clip the edit moved, cropped, masked or animated shows, sequence pixels

complete.description: true: values move in straight lines between entries; false: evenly sampled

corners.description: Corner pin: where the picture corners land, top left, top right, bottom right, bottom left

picture.description: The whole picture, before crop and mask and rotation; for a corner pin, the box around its corners

source.description: The part of the source that shows, source pixels

visible.description: What it shows: crop and mask applied, rotated, inside the frame; null: nothing

frames.description: Frames shown; for a waveform, the start and end of its span

loudness.description: Measured for audio edits, over the waveform span

timeline_id.description: The new version: edit this one next (older ids stay valid)

title: Batch edit
